question: The inner and outer radius of a hollow hemispherical shell are 7 cm and 14 cm respectively. Find the approximate volume of the metal used.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for the volume of a hollow hemisphere: V = ²/₃ × π × (R³ − r³)

Substitute R = 14 cm, r = 7 cm, and π = 3.14:

V = ²/₃ × 3.14 × (14³ − 7³)

V = ²/₃ × 3.14 × (2744 − 343) = ²/₃ × 7539.14

V ≈ 5026.09 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 5026.09 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Outer radius of the hemispherical shell (R) = 14 cm

Inner radius of the hemispherical shell (r) = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of the metal used = Volume of outer hemisphere − Volume of inner hemisphere

Volume = ²/₃
